ephemeris_coverage_assumption.status: The reference planetary SPK coverage includes the required 2026 interval. Verify coverage and compatibility of the actual selected kernel set in Step 4.

visibility_thresholds.comparison: Airless geometric body-center elevation minus the applicable local horizon elevation.

study_assumptions: The baseline date is a reproducible study date, not a planned mission date.
The maximum scenario start offset is 72 hours and each scenario lasts 72 hours, so source coverage is required through baseline plus 144 hours.
Visibility thresholds are geometric center-of-body thresholds; solar-disk fraction and radio or power performance are outside this configuration.
Study points use sourced named-feature centers; they are not official mission-site coordinates. The 1.5 m instrument height is an illustrative assumption, not a hardware specification.
